default_creds.context: Admin UI example credentials from docs -- often copy-pasted as-is by operators

misconfig_patterns: No LITELLM_MASTER_KEY set -- proxy is fully open, all routes unauthenticated
Database URL with default dbpassword9090 from docker-compose example
Prometheus metrics endpoint :9090 exposed without auth
LITELLM_SALT_KEY not set -- provider keys stored unencrypted in DB

active_probe.false_positive_check: response body must contain litellm_version field

deployment_tells: Admin UI at /ui -- prompts for username/password when master_key is set
pivot_paths: GET /v1/models -- lists all configured upstream providers and model names (no auth if no master_key)
GET /key/list -- all virtual keys and their associated provider credentials
GET /logs -- full prompt/response history for all proxied calls
POST /chat/completions with crafted Authorization header -- CVE-2026-42208 SQLi reads key table on unpatched <1.83.7
Host header injection -- CVE-2026-49468 auth bypass on <1.84.0
vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-42208 CVSS 9.3 CISA-KEV: pre-auth SQLi via Authorization header in key verification path; reads proxy key DB; affected 1.81.16-1.83.6; fixed 1.83.7
CVE-2026-49468 CVSS 9.5: auth bypass via Host header injection; auth layer evaluates wrong route; affected <1.84.0; fixed 1.84.0
CVE-2026-35030 CVSS 9.4: OIDC JWT cache key collision (first 20 chars used as key); unauthenticated attacker gains legitimate user session; affected <1.83.0; fixed 1.83.0
CVE-2025-0330: Langfuse API key leakage via team settings parse; affected v1.52.1
